def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 2:
                orbit = [(r,c),(h-1-r,c),(r,w-1-c),(h-1-r,w-1-c),
                         (c,r),(c,w-1-r),(h-1-c,r),(h-1-c,w-1-r)]
                known = [grid[rr][cc] for rr,cc in orbit if grid[rr][cc] != 2]
                if known:
                    out[r][c] = known[0]
    return out
